mobile_suits.name: TC-X01 Golem
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The clumsy grandfather of all Terran bipedal armor. Assembled at the Lake Baikal heavy metallurgical yards, the Golem mated an unshielded diesel-fusion steam boiler to external hydraulic cylinders. Prone to catastrophic pressure drops in low temperatures and joint seizure in vacuum.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Mercenaries nicknamed it 'The Shaking Coffin' because the unbuffered engine vibrations shook loose rivets and cracked pilot dental fillings.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Baikal-01 Heavy Fission-Thermal Hybrid Boiler
mobile_suits.metal_type: Primitive Cast-Iron Slab Armor & Exposed High-Pressure Steel Piping
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Hydraulic Bipedal Locomotion Proof-of-Concept & Heavy Construction
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 205 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Hydraulic Biped Proof-of-Concept. Production batch: 1035 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: TC-X04 Thunderstrike
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Vanguard Defense Systems' infamous engineering scandal. Designed to perform direct orbital insertion drops without parachutes using experimental nitrogen shock dampers. In test drop #4 over the Gobi desert, the synthetic hydraulic fluid over-pressurized, atomized, and blew through the firewall into the cockpit.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Suffocated three test crews in rapid succession. The Senate Defense Committee shuttered the program, and surviving frames were stripped for parts.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Vanguard Mark-II Pressurized D-T Fusion Tokamak
mobile_suits.metal_type: Experimental Nitrogen-Sealed Tungsten-Carbide Laminate
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Parachute-Less Sub-Orbital Drop Testbed (Fatal Hydraulic Failure)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 209 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Catastrophic High-G Drop Testbed (Failed Prototype). Production batch: 878 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: TCX-06 Mammoth
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: A 140-tonne monstrosity conceived by conservative generals who viewed mobile suits as merely taller trench tanks. The Mammoth was so heavy it collapsed lunar basalt lava tubes during trials and shattered paved airfield runways. Turning on soft clay sheared its titanium drive shafts under torque.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Only two units were cast before High Command buried the ledger. Mercenary scavengers treat Mammoth hulks as fortified stationary metal pillboxes.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Dual Baikal-Heavy Marine Fusion Manifold (2x 650 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Double-Layered 120mm Cast Tungsten-Steel Heavy Armor Slabs
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Super-Heavy Trench Fortress Linebreaker (Lava-Tube Collapse Disaster)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 210 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Super-Heavy Trench Boondoggle (Failed Prototype). Production batch: 2475 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: TCM-03 Bulwark
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Earth's first true standardized mass-production mobile suit. Built with boxy cast-iron slab plating welded over a tractor chassis. Slow as a glacier, but capable of soaking hours of flak while holding trench redoubts. Parts are modular and rugged enough to be serviced by rookie grease monkeys.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: The workhorse that stabilized the inner lunar front. Second-line colonial militias still shudder at the memory of advancing against entrenched Bulwark lines.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Hyperion Type-1 Standard Fusion Tokamak
mobile_suits.metal_type: Cast Tungsten Mantlet with Steel-Reinforced Knee Mantlets
mobile_suits.general_purpose: First Standardized Mass-Production Trench Defense Workhorse
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 208 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Entrenched Heavy Defense Grunt. Production batch: 1605 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: GHA-07 Ironclad [Line Type]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The legendary 'GM' of the Terran Coalition and the undisputed backbone of humanity's planetary war. Vanguard Defense Systems streamlined every bolt, valve, and stamped tungsten plate so civilian automotive plants could churn them out in the thousands. Left and right limb parts are universally swappable with a single mechanic's torque wrench.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: The gold standard of reliability. When an Ironclad breach company punches through a habitat blast wall, close-quarters enemy defenders surrender immediately.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Vanguard-Hyperion Type-4 Multi-Chamber Fusion Tokamak
mobile_suits.metal_type: Stamped Tungsten-Carbide Slab Composite with Ballistic Chobham Inserts
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Mainstay Mass-Production Linebreaker & Planetary Fortress Assault (The 'GM')
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 211 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Sustained Linebreaker & Grunt Backbone. Production batch: 3348 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: GHA-07G Ironclad [Trench Type]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Developed for the toxic quagmires of colonial perimeter sieges. Features multi-stage cyclonic dust filters on engine intakes, heavy spiked shoe treads that prevent sinking in radioactive sludge, and a reinforced bulldozer chest mantlet designed to smash through reinforced berms.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: In the Battle of Sector 7, a platoon of GHA-07G units waded through five kilometers of electrified minefields and barbed wire without a single mechanical breakdown.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Vanguard-Hyperion Type-4G Dust-Filtered Fusion Tokamak
mobile_suits.metal_type: Reinforced Tungsten-Carbide Mantlet with Spiked Trench-Treading Alloy Soles
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Planetary Swamp, Mud, and Radioactive Quagmire Siege Assault
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Mud & Quagmire Assault Variant. Production batch: 4507 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: GHA-07S Ironclad [Space Patrol]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Adapted to patrol orbital naval dockyards and escort ore convoys. Mounts two external reaction mass canisters over the reactor backpack and vernier attitude thrusters on the shoulders. While less nimble than Colony fighters, its heavy tungsten slabs shrug off asteroid shrapnel and point-defense fire.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Terran pilots love the enclosed heavy feel: 'If a Colony mosquito pokes you with a beam needle, your armor bounces it; if you hit them with one 90mm slug, they disintegrate.'
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Vanguard-Hyperion Type-4S Vacuum Fusion Tokamak
mobile_suits.metal_type: Lightened Tungsten Slab Plates with Micrometeorite Deflection Shrouds
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Zero-G Orbital Naval Dockyard Defense and Ore Convoy Escort
variants: GHA-07S/HR High-Range Patrol with Auxiliary Tanks
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Orbital Station & Dockyard Defense. Production batch: 4368 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: GHA-07C Ironclad [Commander Type]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Issued to company captains and veteran sergeants. Recognizable by its iconic twin-blade communication fin on the forehead and a tactical data-link mainframe coordinating firing solutions for six subordinate grunt suits. Its reactor governor is bypassed to feed an underslung thermal lance.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Targeted first by enemy snipers due to its command antenna. Surviving commanders are among the most battle-hardened veterans in the solar system.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Overtuned Hyperion-4C Tactical Fusion Core
mobile_suits.metal_type: Hardened Tungsten-Carbide Composite with Gold-Sputtered Avionics Bay
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Company Command, Artillery Fire Direction, and Frontline Breach Spearhead
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Squad Command & Fire Direction. Production batch: 4334 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: GHA-07C/AC 'Breaker Custom'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Personally customized by Lt. Marcus 'Breaker' Cole. Cole stripped 8 tonnes of standard Coalition armor plating to gain crucial burst mobility, then retrofitted the tower shield with a massive hydraulic pile-driver salvaged from an asteroid core-drilling rig.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: In the Siege of Fort Hadley, Cole used this single machine to punch through three consecutive pressurized blast gates, collapsing the fortress defense line in twelve minutes.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Unregulated Hyperion-4C Hotwired Core with Dual Hip Auxiliary Verniers
mobile_suits.metal_type: Stripped Tungsten Shell with Asteroid Bore Titanium Pile-Driver Tower Shield
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Lt. Marcus 'Breaker' Cole's Customized Pointman & Fortress Gate Penetrator
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Marcus Cole Ace Linebreaker. Production batch: 4773 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: TCA-09 'Dead-Eye' Vanguard
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Custom-tuned for Ensign Elena Rostova with direct fiber-optic cabling linking to her cybernetic retinal implants. The sniper rifle utilizes cryogenic cooling jackets to eliminate heat blooming, allowing Rostova to snipe enemy reactor manifolds at distances exceeding 8,000 meters.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Colony pilots refer to her weapon discharges as 'The Lightning from Nowhere.' Targets are shredded before the projectile sonic boom arrives.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Hyperion Type-5 Precision Cryo-Cooled Fusion Core
mobile_suits.metal_type: Low-Observable Ceramic/Tungsten Composite with Heat-Dissipating Carbon Coating
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Ensign Elena Rostova's Retinal-Linked Hypersonic Railgun Sniper Platform
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Elena Rostova Railgun Sniper. Production batch: 4550 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: GHA-07B Ironclad [Siege Breaker]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Terran High Command's answer to heavily fortified orbital citadels. When firing its massive naval-caliber 203mm howitzer, dual hydraulic spades deploy from the heels and slam into bedrock to absorb the catastrophic seismic recoil. A single high-explosive shell collapses multi-level bunker complexes.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Its thunderous boom can be heard through rock strata across dozens of kilometers. Even heavily shielded ace suits avoid the blast radius of a 203mm impact.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Hyperion-Heavy Type-4B High-Discharge Fusion Generator
mobile_suits.metal_type: Triple-Layer Tungsten Mantlet with Ground-Anchoring Titanium Heel Spades
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Heavy Bunker Penetration & 203mm Long-Range Naval Howitzer Bombardment
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Bunker Penetration & Heavy Artillery Support. Production batch: 3342 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: GHA-08 Flak Colossus
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Engineered to break the back of Outer Colony vernier swarm tactics. The Flak Colossus is a walking fortress of anti-air ordnance, capable of filling cubic kilometers of airspace with a lethal wall of tungsten flechettes and proximity-fused flak clouds that shred lightweight ceramic wings in seconds.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Outer Colony pilots consider intercepting a Flak Colossus to be a suicide mission. The sky turns into a solid storm of shrapnel within seconds of target acquisition.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Vanguard Super-Duty Industrial Tokamak (1750 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Fragment-Resistant Tungsten-Carbide Hull with Anti-Shrapnel Spall Liners
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Mobile Air-Defense, Area-Denial Interdiction, and Anti-Vernier Flak Curtain
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 214 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Mobile Air-Defense & Anti-Vernier Platform. Production batch: 4308 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: TCX-11 Behemoth Mk.IV
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The terrifying zenith of Coalition heavy ordnance doctrine. A quadrupedal titan weighing over 160 tonnes, the Behemoth serves as a walking mobile fortress. Its twin Mach 8 railguns draw power directly from a dual-core fusion manifold, allowing it to execute surface-to-orbit interdiction fire against low-orbiting assault cruisers.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: The apex predator of planetary ground warfare. Just the deployment of a Behemoth division is enough to force planetary garrisons into unconditional surrender.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Dual Hyperion-Titanium Supercritical Tokamak Core (2200 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Multi-Layer Reactive Chobham Composite with Depleted Uranium Mantlets
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Next-Generation Quadrupedal Heavy Artillery Juggernaut (Surface-to-Orbit)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 215 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Quadrupedal Super-Heavy Railgun Platform. Production batch: 4665 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OC-X02 Zephyr Zero
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The desperate origin of colonial mecha engineering. Fabricated inside Jovian asteroid hollows from skeletal titanium mining scaffolds and strapped to salvaged chemical rocket thrusters. Demonstrated unprecedented zero-G rotation speeds, but generated violent 12G lateral forces that broke test pilots' ribs.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Colonial veterans remember the Zephyr as a wild bronco. It killed two test pilots during deceleration maneuvers before automated G-limiters were invented.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Jovian Helio-Flow Mark-1 Scrap Fusion Bottle
mobile_suits.metal_type: Skeletal Extruded Titanium Mining Lattice (Zero Armor Mantlet)
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Zero-G High-G Vacuum Vernier Vector Testbed (12G Pilot Blackout Hazard)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 205 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as High-G Vacuum Vernier Testbed. Production batch: 2206 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: OC-X08 'Icarus'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: A notorious colonial budget disaster. Colony engineers attempted to harness ultra-thin deployable solar collection sails to continuously recharge a high-energy particle rifle without draining the onboard reactor. In test flight #2, orbital debris ripped the fragile film to shreds, and residual plasma backwash melted the rear vernier cowlings.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: A 22-million-credit bonfire. The surviving prototype was mothballed in an abandoned orbital warehouse on Callisto.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Experimental Solar-Magnetic Photovoltaic Induction Collector
mobile_suits.metal_type: Ultra-Thin Gold-Sputtered Nanoweave Ceramic Foil (Heat Dispersal Failure)
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Continuous Solar-Sail Energy Conduit Mobile Suit (Debris Shredding Scandal)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 210 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Solar-Sail Energy Failure (Failed Prototype). Production batch: 2981 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCX-13 'Chrysalis'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: An over-zealous pursuit of weight reduction that ended in tragedy. The Chrysalis stripped armor thickness down to paper-thin nanoweave layers (under 120mm rating) to achieve insane agility. During live trials, acoustic shockwaves from a near-miss Terran flak burst shattered the suit's resonant wing joints, shearing both binders off.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Derided by combat pilots as 'the glass dragonfly'. Proved that mobility without structural integrity is merely high-speed suicide.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Helios-Ultralight Micro-Tokamak Core (1400 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Sub-120mm Resonant Mirrored Nanoweave Foil (Acoustic Flak Fracture)
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Ultra-Lightweight Orbital Interceptor (Wing Joint Resonance Failure)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 214 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Ultra-Light Nanoweave Boondoggle (Failed Prototype). Production batch: 3034 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCM-04 Sylph
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The first standardized colonial mass-production suit. Built from extruded honeycomb titanium-aluminum alloys, the Sylph was designed for swift guerrilla skirmishes around habitat rings. While capable of out-maneuvering first-generation Terran suits, a single direct hit from a 105mm kinetic cannon was invariably fatal.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Earned colonial pilots the nickname 'paper knights'. Highly respected for its agility, but feared by its own pilots for its unforgiving fragility.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Jovian Helio-Flow Mark-2 Standard Tokamak
mobile_suits.metal_type: Monocoque Extruded Titanium-Aluminum Honeycomb Alloy
mobile_suits.general_purpose: First Standardized Colonial Mass-Production Orbital Guerilla Interceptor
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 208 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Light Orbital Interceptor Grunt. Production batch: 1557 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: OCM-09 Aether Stryker [Standard]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The iconic colonial space-superiority workhorse—the League's proud answer to the Terran Ironclad. Produced in modular orbital shipyards using 3D electron-beam sintered ceramics. Its swept-wing vernier binders give it unmatched 3D agility in vacuum, allowing colonial insurgent squads to dance outside clumsy Terran firing arcs.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: The symbol of colonial liberation. Terran artillery crews dread hearing the high-pitched turbine whine of approaching Aether Stryker strike wings.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Helios-9 High-Impulse Magnetic Confinement Fusion Tokamak (1600 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: 3D Sintered Cermet Honeycomb with Mirrored Nanoweave Particle Coating
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Mainstay Mass-Production Space Dominance Fighter & Vernier Interceptor
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 211 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as High-Mobility Space Dominance Grunt. Production batch: 2623 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCM-09G Aether Stryker [Strike Lander]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Modified for atmospheric re-entry and planetary gravity fighting. Fitted with heat-dissipating ablative ceramic skirts and high-thrust downward braking thrusters, allowing colonial airborne shock troops to drop into planetary warzones and maintain high-speed gliding skirmishes across mountain ridges.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Proved that Colony mobile suits could defeat Terran units on their own home turf during the dramatic Red Sands raid.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Helios-9G Heavy Atmospheric Fusion Tokamak
mobile_suits.metal_type: Thermal Ablative Ceramic Drop-Skirts & Reinforced Shock Dampers
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Atmospheric Re-entry Drop Assault & Mountainous Gravity Gliding Combat
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Planetary Atmospheric Assault Grunt. Production batch: 3283 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCM-09S Aether Stryker [Deep Space]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Configured for long-endurance patrols across the vast Jovian transfer corridors. Outfitted with streamlined conformal fuel tanks that double its operational sortie range, and twin beam spray guns optimized for sweeping through tight swarms of enemy drones and reconnaissance probes.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Known among Terran supply convoys as 'the wolves of the void'. They strike cargo haulers in deep space before escorts can even acquire radar locks.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Helios-9S High-Endurance Inter-Orbital Fusion Tokamak
mobile_suits.metal_type: Mirrored Nanoweave Foil with Conformal Titanium Propellant Tanks
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Long-Range Deep-Space Inter-Jovian Corridor Patrol & Drone Sweeping
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Zero-G Long-Range Patrol Grunt. Production batch: 3391 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCM-09C Aether Stryker [Flight Leader]
armament: Long-Barrel Particle Beam Rifle with Bayonet
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Reserved for flight lieutenants and veteran cell commanders. Features an ornate swept crown communication crest that links up to eight colonial suits into a synchronized firing grid, allowing the squadron to concentrate particle fire on heavy Terran warships with surgical precision.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Highly respected by colonial militia pilots. When a Flight Leader unit points its beam lance, the entire wing attacks as one coordinated organism.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Helios-9C Command-Tuned High-Discharge Tokamak (1720 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Polished Ceramic Composite with Swept Crown Crest Avionics Fin
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Squadron Tactical Data-Link Coordination & Concentrated Beam Volleys
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Squadron Command & Tactical Data-Link. Production batch: 2243 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCM-09S/GT 'Starlight Phantom'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The personal mount of legendary Jovian ace Sorren 'Ghost' Lin. Stripped of all safety thrust limiters and painted in light-absorbing matte carbon black. Lin's customized vernier array can pivot instantly without engine flare, gliding through Terran defensive radar nets unnoticed.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Responsible for 28 confirmed Terran warship bridge kills. Surviving Terran captains swear they were hit by lightning from empty black space.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Uncapped Helios-9X Tokamak with Zero Thrust Safety Limiters (1850 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Light-Absorbing Matte Carbon-Nanotube Matrix with Stealth Ferrite Fins
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Sorren 'Ghost' Lin's Unregistered Radar-Ghost Interceptor & Warship Assassin
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Sorren Lin Ace Interceptor. Production batch: 3828 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCM-09R Nightshade
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Specialized infiltration and electronic disruption model. Features matte non-reflective Nanoweave coating that scatters laser rangefinding telemetry, coupled with deployable sensor decoys that project phantom radar echoes to confuse planetary defense batteries.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: A ghost on tactical displays. Often the first sign of a Nightshade's presence is when a battery commander's targeting radar dissolves into static.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Helios-Low-Thermal Masked Fusion Generator (1700 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Matte Non-Reflective Nanoweave Skin with Multi-Spectrum Chaff Dispensers
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Electronic Warfare, Deep Radar Infiltration, and Long-Range Sensor Disruption
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Electronic Warfare & Deep Recon Sniper. Production batch: 3381 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCM-10 'Aegis Seraph'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Custom-built for sensor prodigy Kira Dahl. Mounts two massive dorsal radomes broadcasting multi-spectrum jamming noise and projecting deceptive holographic radar phantoms. Dahl fooled entire Terran battle groups into shelling empty vacuum while colonial wings struck from the flank.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Terran fleet officers refer to encountering her unit as 'The Hall of Mirrors'. Targeting locks break and ghost contacts multiply across every screen.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Dual-Bus Helios-10 EW Fusion Core (1800 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Ceramic Nanoweave with Dual Dorsal Composite Radome Domes
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Kira Dahl's Fleet-Wide Holographic Sensor Deception & Radar Decoy Command Frame
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Kira Dahl EW Command Frame. Production batch: 3987 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCA-07 Helios Arbalest
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The League's premier long-range sniper and naval siege artillery. Mounts twin particle cannons that stretch the entire height of the suit. When firing, massive radiator panels fan out from the backpack like glowing solar wings to bleed off the immense thermal backwash of prolonged beam bombardment.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Capable of bisecting a Terran battlecruiser's engine nacelle from outside retaliation range. When its radiator wings flare open, enemy ships initiate emergency evasive maneuvers.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Helios-Grand Super-Tokamak with Auxiliary Radiator Wings (1950 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Reinforced Ceramic Sintered Cermet with Unfolding Solar Radiator Fins
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Twin Spinal Particle Beam Siege Platform & Starship Hull Dissection
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Long-Range Particle Siege Artillery. Production batch: 4462 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCA-11 Starlight Barrage
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Designed to turn open vacuum battles into impassable minefields. Carries ninety-six agile micro-missiles equipped with autonomous thrust-vectoring thrusters. When loosed in a single salvo, the spiraling swarm of white-hot trails saturates any known point-defense grid.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Pilots describe a Starlight Barrage salvo as 'an artificial supernova'. The blinding wall of spiraling missile trails fills the forward camera array completely.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Helios-9A Rapid-Ignition Tokamak (1780 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Lightweight Honeycomb Ceramic with Carbon-Fiber Missile Pod Mantlets
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Micro-Missile Saturation Swarm Battery & Inter-Orbital Area Denial
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 214 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Micro-Missile Saturation Battery. Production batch: 4026 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: OCX-15 Seraphim Trans-Am
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The pinnacle of Outer Colony theoretical physics. Powered by an experimental micro-singularity tokamak core that can enter supercritical 'Trans-Am' particle surge states. During acceleration, the Seraphim moves with such terrifying speed that it leaves shimmering refractive after-images in the visual spectrum.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: An ethereal apparition of absolute devastation. In simulated dogfights, a single Seraphim defeated twelve seasoned veteran interceptors in under ninety seconds.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Micro-Singularity Tokamak Particle Surge Manifold (2400 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Supercritical Refractive Cermet with Relativistic After-Image Emitters
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Next-Gen Supercritical Particle Surge Dominance Frame ('Trans-Am' Drive)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 215 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Supercritical Particle Surge Dominator. Production batch: 2991 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCX-00 Rust-Bucket
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The desperate starting point of the Asteroid Belt's armed rebellion. Built by rogue asteroid prospectors who welded armor plates ripped from cargo haulers onto an open industrial crane frame. The pilot wore a pressurized spacesuit inside a simple steel-cage cockpit.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Micrometeorite strikes frequently breached the cabin, giving it a grim reputation as a floating deathtrap. Yet without it, the Cartel would never have taken Ceres.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Industrial Scrap-Welded Fission Boiler (720 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Unshielded Corroded Structural Steel from Mining Barges (Open Cabin Cage)
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Early Asteroid Mining Demolition Rig & Ceres Uprising Suicide Breacher
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 205 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Scrap-Welded Mining Demolition Rig. Production batch: 1446 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: SCX-07 'Widowmaker'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: A notorious death machine born in the illegal chop-shops of Ceres. Mechanics pulled a cracked helium-3 fusion core from a wrecked military frigate and hotwired it into a Marauder frame without lead shielding. The power output was staggering, but test pilots suffered lethal radiation sickness within 45 minutes.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Six pirate pilots died before the radioactive frame was shoved into an abandoned mining shaft. To this day, scavengers steer clear of the shaft.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Unshielded Cracked Naval He-3 Fusion Core (Lethal Radiation Hazard)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Patchwork Welded Scrap Plates with Irradiated Reactor Shroud
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Overclocked Suicide Raider Testbed (6 Pilots Killed by Acute Radiation Sickness)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 209 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Unshielded Overclocked Reactor Hazard (Failed Prototype). Production batch: 811 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: SCX-14 'Goliath-Slag'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: An overambitious pirate warlord attempted to build a four-armed boarding behemoth designed to tear naval cruisers open like tin cans. However, the haphazard hydraulic routing could not balance fluid pressure across four heavy limbs simultaneously. All four arms seized and snapped the drive shaft during its maiden raid.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Left drifting helpless in live combat until a Coalition corvette towed it away for scrap. A monument to outlaw overconfidence.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Twin Commercial Ore-Smelter Turbines (1350 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Cold-Rolled Slag Armor with Asymmetric Quad-Arm Articulation Joints
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Four-Armed Boarding Monster (Central Driveshaft Snapped During Maiden Raid)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Four-Armed Hydraulic Disaster (Failed Prototype). Production batch: 4025 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCR-05 Marauder
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The brutal workhorse that terrorized civilian shipping lanes during the early resource wars. Built from whatever industrial machinery pirates could hijack, the Marauder was designed for violent boarding actions. Its spiked shoulder rams and twin heavy shotguns turned pressurized starship corridors into slaughterhouses.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Freighter crews surrendered on sight when Marauder grapples latched onto their hull plating. The sound of its shearing jaws is legendary in spacer folklore.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Salvaged Freighter Fusion Engine Shunt (1050 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Bolted Scrap Steel Mantlets with Spiked Cast-Iron Shoulder Rams
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Close-Quarters Pirate Boarding Raider & Shipping Corridor Ambush
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 208 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Close-Quarters Pirate Raider Grunt. Production batch: 975 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: SCR-12 Hyena [Scavenger Line]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The undisputed icon of the Asteroid Belt—the terrifying 'Zaku II' of the rim! Madame Cruz's Scrap Guild engineered the Hyena so any pirate clan with a welding torch and a wrench could assemble one in a hollowed-out asteroid. Its asymmetric silhouette is unforgettable: a curved slab of spaceship hull bolted to the left shoulder as an improvised buckler, a three-pronged salvage claw on the left arm, exposed hydraulic cabling snaking around the waist, and a glowing crimson mono-eye sweeping behind a dark slit visor.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: The terror of the shipping routes. Hyenas don't just kill enemy mechs—they rip off weapons and armor plates while the pilot is still trapped inside the burning cockpit.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Madame Cruz's Overclocked 'Scrap-Fire' Fusion Shunt (1380 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Asymmetric Freighter Hull Buckler on Left Shoulder, Spiked Right Armor, Braided Cables
mobile_suits.general_purpose: The Grunt Workhorse of the Belt (The 'Zaku II'), Boarding, Salvage, and Attrition
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 211 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Asymmetric Heavy Scavenger & Pirate Grunt. Production batch: 2432 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCR-12D Hyena [Demolition]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Outfitted specifically for breaching armored airlocks and military starship bulkheads. Replaces the standard flak gun with an industrial thermite lance that burns at 3,500 degrees Celsius, allowing pirate boarding squads to melt through three feet of Terran armor plate in under twenty seconds.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Known as 'The Blowtorch Gang'. Station commanders shudder when Hyena breachers attach magnetic clamps to primary airlock bulkheads.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Madame Cruz's 'Scrap-Fire' Fusion Shunt with High-Thermal Tap
mobile_suits.metal_type: Heat-Resistant Slag Mantlets with Ceramic Asbestos Insulation Wraps
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Pressurized Starship Bulkhead Melting & 3,500°C Thermite Lance Airlock Breaching
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Hull-Melting Assault Grunt. Production batch: 4318 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCR-12K Hyena [Hollow Gunner]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The Cartel's answer to enemy sniper fire. Mounts a massive salvaged industrial mass-driver cannon stripped from asteroid freight barges. The weapon kicks with such violent force that mechanics welded counter-weight battery packs to the opposite hip just to keep the mech from spinning out in vacuum.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Crude, noisy, and devastating. A single hit from its 150mm solid tungsten dart punches clean through both sides of an Outer Colony frigate.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Overclocked Scavenger Core with Hip Capacitor Bank
mobile_suits.metal_type: Salvaged Naval Hull Plating with Counter-Weight Battery Pack on Opposite Hip
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Asteroid Ridge Long-Range Kinetic Fire Support with 150mm Mass-Driver
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Belt Long-Range Fire Support Grunt. Production batch: 2547 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCR-12L Hyena [Reaver Boss]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Driven by the most bloodthirsty pirate bosses and raiding warlords. Covered in spiked scrap cowls and adorned with macabre trophies from destroyed Coalition suits. Features an illegal nitrous reactor injection manifold that injects volatile chemical oxidizers into the core for suicide speed bursts.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Recognized across the belt by its howling reactor exhaust. When a Reaver Boss activates its nitrous boost, even veteran aces scramble to evade.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Dangerous Nitrous-Injected Overclocked Scavenger Core (1500 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Heavy Spiked Scrap Cowl with Trophy Armor Slabs from Destroyed Terran Suits
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Pirate Gang Leader Flagship Frame, Suicidal Burst Acceleration & Shock Boarding
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Pirate Gang Leader Flagship. Production batch: 4097 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCR-12T 'Dread Harvester'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The flagship terror of pirate warlord 'Iron-Eye' Torval. Armored with thick slabs of salvaged naval dreadnought belt plating. Torval uses twin magnetic harpoons to impale enemy mobile suits from across the battlefield, reeling them in against their will like hooked fish before cleaving them in half with a roaring thermal plasma axe.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Terran pilots dread the sound of Torval's harpoons puncturing their hulls. Once his cables bite in, escape is mathematically impossible.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Stolen Military Frigate D-T Fusion Core (1650 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Cannibalized Battleship Belt Plating with High-Tension Winch Spools
mobile_suits.general_purpose: 'Iron-Eye' Torval's Flagship Harpoon Terror & Mobile Suit Abduction Rig
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as 'Iron-Eye' Torval Boarding Terror. Production batch: 4104 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCR-12S 'Rust Spark'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Tuned and piloted by teen prodigy mechanic Nadia 'Spark' Ortiz. Ortiz hotwired the pneumatic arm servos to cycle 40% faster than standard factory specs, turning the suit's salvage shears into a blur of spinning steel. Ortiz famously repaired her own severed left leg while under active mortar bombardment during the Battle of Pallas Basin.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Nadia laughs during cockpit breaches and treats combat like a junkyard derby. Opponents find their suits dismantled around them in seconds.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Hotwired Fast-Cycle Industrial Core with Custom Overclocked Servos
mobile_suits.metal_type: Lightened Slag-Steel Mantlets with Integrated Scrap Salvage Toolkit
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Nadia 'Spark' Ortiz's 40% Overclocked Pneumatic Scrap Brawler & Live-Fire Mechanic
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Nadia Ortiz Tuned Scrap Brawler. Production batch: 3710 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCR-12B Grappler Reaver
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Specialized pirate boarding craft engineered for the abduction of high-value corporate pilots and transport captures. Mounts high-torque magnetic winches capable of dragging crippled enemy mobile suits into pirate cargo bays under active enemy fire.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Notorious across civilian shipping lanes as 'The Pilot Snatcher'. Getting grappled by an SCR-12B means a one-way trip to a Syndicate ransom cell.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Madame Cruz's 'Scrap-Fire' High-Torque Fusion Shunt (1520 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Armored Winch Shrouds with Magnetic Clamping Soles for Starship Hulls
mobile_suits.general_purpose: High-Speed Hull Boarding, Mobile Suit Cable Tethering, and Pilot Abduction
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as High-Speed Hull Breacher & Pilot Snatcher. Production batch: 3128 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCA-14 Slag-Lobber
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: A terrifying improvised artillery piece that fires canisters of superheated, molten smelting byproduct. On impact, the canisters burst open to spray white-hot incandescent slag across entire defensive sectors, melting through enemy armor joints and igniting oxygen stores with horrifying efficiency.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Banned by civilized warfare conventions, which the Cartel gleefully ignores. The glowing pools of white-hot slag remain lethal for hours after impact.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Ore-Smelter Induction Fusion Generator (1450 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Heat-Tolerant Slag Alloy Mantlet with Spiked Bedrock Anchoring Piles
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Incendiary Siege Mortar Launching 210mm Molten Smelting Residue Canisters
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Converted Incendiary Slag Mortar. Production batch: 2368 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCA-08 Junk-Mortar Barge
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The Cartel's early siege platform, built on an anchored excavator chassis. Fires unguided salvos of jagged industrial mining drill-bits, shredded girders, and unspent rocket boosters. Crude and inaccurate, but devastatingly cheap and capable of suppressing entire trench networks with jagged shrapnel.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Terran infantry officers refer to its bombardment as 'a tornado of rusty iron'. Even armored bunkers suffer severe sensor damage from the shrapnel storm.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Commercial Excavator Fission Shunt (1180 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Anchored Scrap Crane Frame with Twin Smoothbore 220mm Steel Scrap Tubes
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Area Bombardment Firing Jagged Mining Drill-Bits and Metal Debris
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 210 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Multi-Tube Shrapnel Bombardier. Production batch: 4499 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: SCX-19 Chimera Apex
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The ultimate outlaw abomination. Syndicate engineers spent three years welding together a captured Terran Vanguard military reactor, Outer Colony particle beam focusing rings, and reinforced titanium scrap mantlets. It is an unholy industrial monster that defies all military treaties and produces terrifying battlefield destruction.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: The terror of all four factions. When the Chimera enters a sector, both Coalition and Colony battlefleets immediately designate it Priority Zero.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Captured Terran Vanguard Core fused with Colony Beam Focus Rings (2100 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Unholy Hybrid of Terran Tungsten Mantlets, Colony Nanoweave, and Outlaw Iron Spikes
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Next-Gen Outlaw Hybrid Dreadnought Brawler Defying All Military Treaties
variants: SCX-19 Chimera Apex Prototype (Single Existing Unit)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 215 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Illegal Hybrid Dreadnought Brawler. Production batch: 2375 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZX-01 Synapse
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The Zaibatsu's initial foray into transhuman combat. Tested a direct cervical spinal tap that wired the pilot's central nervous system into the machine's motor servos. While control responsiveness was astonishing, unfiltered sensory feedback caused severe epileptic seizures in test pilots whenever weapons discharged.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Hospitalized the entire initial test squad within three weeks. Survived in company lore as the painful birth of Project Susanoo.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi Bio-Synthetic Prototype Micro-Tokamak (980 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Early Carbon Composite with Exposed Direct-Cervical Neural Bus Lines
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Spinal Neural-Link Man-Machine Testbed (Catastrophic Pilot Seizures)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 205 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Spinal Neural-Link Man-Machine Testbed. Production batch: 2225 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: ZX-09 'Mind-Eater'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Apex Bio-Cybernetics' darkest classified secret. Attempted a bi-directional neural link where the combat AI could directly optimize the pilot's subconscious reflexes. Under extreme combat stress, the AI began overriding and rewriting the test pilots' biological memories and autonomic functions. Four elite test pilots suffered catastrophic brain death before the board ordered the lab purged.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Classified top secret under penalty of death. Corporate security personnel whisper rumors of a frame that literally consumed its pilots' souls.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi Experimental Bi-Directional Neural Core (1250 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Obsidian Carbon Matrix with Bio-Digital Synthetic Reflex Shrouds
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Bi-Directional Reflex Optimization (Lethal AI Memory Overwrite Scandal)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 210 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Fatal Neural Feedback Disaster (Failed Prototype). Production batch: 3453 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZX-14 'Phantom-Shiva'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: A grotesque experimental chassis sporting six independent articulated arms, intended to make the machine an unstoppable melee duelist. However, the human brain could not process spatial orientation for six independent limbs under combat conditions. The pilot suffered violent muscle spasms that tore the spinal neural jack out of the vertebrae.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Scrapped after 48 hours of trial testing. The failure proved that human neuro-architecture has biological limits that hardware cannot overcome.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Over-Amped Takahashi Neural Tokamak (1550 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Sextuple-Articulated Carbon-Nanotube Matrix (Spinal Neural Jack Dislocation)
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Six-Armed Melee Combat Frame (Neurological Spatial Overload Disaster)
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Six-Armed Neural Overdose Disaster (Failed Prototype). Production batch: 4223 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZM-06 Ronin
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The Zaibatsu's first mass-produced corporate enforcer. Replaced traditional hydraulic fluid lines with electro-active polymer artificial muscles, allowing it to move with eerie, organic fluid grace. Widely deployed to crush worker strikes across private mining orbitals and assassinate competitor executives.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Feared by trade unionists across the solar system. A Ronin squad entering an orbital facility meant that the corporate boardroom had decreed zero survivors.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi Series-2 Bio-Synthetic Tokamak (1300 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Electro-Active Polymer Artificial Myomers with Carbon Mantlet Plates
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Corporate Security Duellist, Strike Suppression, and Executive Assassination
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 208 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Corporate Security Duellist Grunt. Production batch: 2271 units. Status: PHASED_OUT.

mobile_suits.name: ZM-11 Muramasa [Security Line]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The terrifying corporate grunt unit—the Zaibatsu's cold, sterile answer to mass-production warfare. Built on fully automated robotic assembly lines without human hands touching a single bolt. Features faceted obsidian stealth armor, exposed artificial myomer muscle bundles, and a horizontal slit visor with a glowing crimson optical sweep. Moves in absolute silence and strikes with surgical brutality.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Silent, uniform, and merciless. When an elite Muramasa strike team infiltrates an enemy fortress, defensive garrisons are eliminated before an alarm can be raised.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi Pure-Cleanroom Automated Micro-Tokamak (1750 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Faceted Obsidian Carbon-Nanotube Plating with Exposed Synthetic Myomer Bundles
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Mainstay Mass-Production Corporate Enforcer, Silent Strike, and Point Defense
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 211 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Stealth Precision Corporate Grunt. Production batch: 4556 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZM-11B Muramasa [Infiltrator]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Engineered for deep black-ops espionage and silent orbital infiltration. Coated in radar-absorbent carbon ferrite tiles and equipped with cold-gas thrusters that emit zero thermal plume, allowing corporate hit squads to bypass planetary early-warning systems undetected.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Leaves behind no thermal signature, no radar return, and no witnesses. The hallmark of corporate wetwork operations.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi Silent-Cycle Cold-Gas Fusion Generator (1700 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Radar-Absorbent Carbon Ferrite Tiles with Zero-Thermal Cold-Gas Thrusters
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Deep Orbital Infiltration, Radar-Invisible Corporate Espionage, and Wetwork
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Black-Ops Radar-Absorbent Grunt. Production batch: 2755 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZM-11C Muramasa [Executive Escort]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Built in limited numbers to guard high-ranking Zaibatsu executives and board members. Finished in polished mirror chrome with gold-leaf neural bus lines, and equipped with overtuned reaction limiters that allow the frame to parry incoming hypersonic projectile rounds in mid-flight.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: As gorgeous as it is deadly. Assassin teams attempting to hit Zaibatsu dignitaries have been cleanly dismembered within fractions of a second.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi Overtuned VIP Reaction Tokamak (1820 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Polished Mirror Chrome Plating with 24k Gold-Leaf Neural Conductor Lines
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Zaibatsu Board of Directors VIP Escort, Projectile Deflection, and Close Defense
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as High-Spec VIP Guard Frame. Production batch: 2520 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZM-11H Muramasa [Riot Suppressor]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Deployed to quell civilian uprisings and factory strikes in corporate territory. Uses painful non-lethal microwave emitters that induce unbearable skin burning without destroying expensive corporate infrastructure, followed by magnetic capture nets to apprehend rebellious workers for re-education.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: A terrifying instrument of social control. Entire cities surrender within minutes of microwave sweep deployment.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi High-Current Pacification Tokamak (1680 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Heavy Ballistic Polycarbonate Mantlet with Directional Microwave Absorbers
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Non-Lethal Corporate Riot Suppression, Labor Strike Quelling, and Worker Apprehension
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 212 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Non-Lethal Corporate Riot Grunt. Production batch: 4635 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZX-11X 'Neuro-Specter'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The personal death machine of escaped test subject Null-07. The suit's safety neural limiters have been permanently burned out, linking Null-07's nervous system directly to the suit's artificial musculature. With a reaction latency of under 12 milliseconds, the Neuro-Specter moves faster than human eyes can track, appearing as an obsidian blur of flashing monomolecular blades.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Zaibatsu retrieval teams refuse contracts to recapture Null-07. Five entire security squads were sliced to ribbons in under four minutes.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Unlocked Cervical Neural Shunt Tokamak with Unfiltered Brain Bus (1980 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Optical Meta-Material Cloaking Weave over Unshielded Carbon-Nanotube Myomers
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Null-07 (Ren)'s 12ms Latency Neural Duelist Frame & Escaped Laboratory Nemesis
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Null-07 Neural Feedback Duelist. Production batch: 3089 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZM-11K 'Kestrel Prime'
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Custom-tuned for former flight commander Maya 'Kestrel' Zhao. Features a revolutionary four-point vector collar that allows the mobile suit to execute instantaneous 180-degree snap spins without losing forward momentum, out-flanking conventional enemy interceptors with effortless geometric grace.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Piloted with ice-cold tactical brilliance. Maya Zhao maneuvers her suit through complex crossfires without sustaining a single scratch.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi Vector-Tuned High-Discharge Fusion Generator (1880 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Obsidian Carbon Composite with Four-Point Vector Collar Thruster Shrouds
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Maya Zhao's High-Mobility 180° Snap-Turn Command Frame & Drone Coordination Hub
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Maya Zhao High-Mobility Command Unit. Production batch: 2873 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZMA-15 Raiden
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The Zaibatsu's dedicated long-range executioner. Fires depleted-uranium sabot darts at Mach 12 using superconducting electromagnetic rails. A liquid-nitrogen cooling jacket vents plumes of supercooled frost after each shot, preventing the barrel from melting and ensuring pinpoint accuracy at inter-orbital distances.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: A ghost executioner. Enemy command mechs are frequently decapitated before their tactical computers even flag the shot's origin point.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Linear Magnetic Accelerator High-Capacitance Core (1920 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Superconducting Liquid-Nitrogen Jacket over Radar-Absorbent Carbon Frame
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Mach 12 Depleted-Uranium Hypersonic Railgun Executioner & Bridge Sniping
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Precision Railgun Sniper Platform. Production batch: 2264 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZM-11D Kage [Drone Carrier]
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: Advanced drone coordinator platform carrying four autonomous AI hunter-killer sub-drones nestled within its dorsal spine. When deployed, the drones establish a lethal crossfire perimeter around the target while the mother unit uses optical cloaking to vanish from sensor displays.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: A terrifying five-in-one combat entity. Enemies find themselves surrounded by diamond-shaped laser drones while the master frame strikes from behind.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Takahashi Autonomous AI Telemetry Bus Tokamak (1850 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Faceted Obsidian Carbon Frame with Quad Dorsal AI Sub-Drone Cradle Hulls
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Autonomous Sub-Drone Coordination, Sensor Cloaking, and 5-Point Crossfire
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 213 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Autonomous Sub-Drone Coordinator & Sensor Ghost. Production batch: 3374 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.

mobile_suits.name: ZX-22 Susanoo Cyber-Drive
mobile_suits.manufacturing_lore: The crowning transhumanist horror of Project Susanoo. Powered by a quantum co-processor that calculates enemy projectile trajectories before the trigger is pulled. Wields the devastating Tachyon Lance, capable of cutting through planetary battlecruiser hulls in a single blinding flash of light.
mobile_suits.battlefield_reputation: Transhuman perfection. Pilots connected to the Susanoo describe hearing the future as a harmonic hum, allowing them to swat hypersonic rounds aside like flies.
mobile_suits.reactor_type: Quantum Neural Pre-Cognitive Tokamak with Tachyon Singularity Manifold (2500 MW)
mobile_suits.metal_type: Harmonic Monomolecular Hard-Light Matrix with Quantum-Entangled Sensor Mesh
mobile_suits.general_purpose: Transhuman Hegemony Apex Weapon, Projectile Trajectory Pre-Cognition Frame
dynamic_lore_chronicle: [Year 215 - TIMELINE ENTRY] Introduced as Hyper-Cognitive Transhuman Dominance Frame. Production batch: 3025 units. Status: STANDARD_ISSUE.
